description: The rest of the business's situation, behind the brief in input.situation: pass one name from input.situation.more and get that part whole (the funnel's arithmetic, the calendar's work and later slots, a number day by day and by channel, why a number is not counted and the owner's step, the work that failed or was cancelled and why, the site's checks, the catalogue's changes, what may be claimed). Pass all only when the question needs most of it: it is large. Returns { part, value }; a name it does not have is refused with the list of names. A part inside a part may be named by its path, with dots.

part.description: A name from input.situation.more, or all for everything.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: situation_read
title: Situation read
